name: ring
description: QuelitonSouza plugin marketplace: Core software engineering skills (TDD, debugging, code review), specialized developer agents (Backend, DevOps, Frontend, QA, SRE), product planning workflows (9-gate pre-dev system), FinOps/regulatory compliance for Brazilian financial systems (BACEN, RFB), and technical writing specialists for documentation.

plugins.name: ring-default
plugins.description: Core skills library for the Lerian Team: TDD, debugging, collaboration patterns, and proven techniques. Features parallel 3-reviewer code review system (Foundation, Correctness, Safety), systematic debugging, and workflow orchestration. 21 essential skills for software engineering excellence.

plugins.name: ring-dev-team
plugins.description: 7 specialized developer agents + 10 development skills + 5 slash commands: 6-gate development cycle (implementation->devops->SRE->testing->review->validation), integrated with PM team output. Go/TypeScript Backend specialists, DevOps Engineer, Frontend TypeScript specialist, Frontend Designer, QA Analyst, and SRE. Complete development team coverage with TDD, observability, and security best practices.

plugins.name: ring-pm-team
plugins.description: Product team pre-development workflow: 10 skills + 3 research agents. 9-gate planning system with research-first approach (Gate 0) before PRD creation. Includes parallel research agents (repo-research-analyst, best-practices-researcher, framework-docs-researcher) and full planning gates (PRD, feature map, TRD, API, data model, dependencies, tasks, subtasks).

plugins.name: ring-pmo-team
plugins.description: PMO (Project Management Office) specialists for portfolio-level oversight: 5 agents (portfolio-manager, resource-planner, risk-analyst, governance-specialist, executive-reporter), 8 skills for portfolio planning, resource allocation, risk management, and executive reporting. Complements ring-pm-team (single feature) with portfolio-level coordination.

plugins.name: ring-finops-team
plugins.description: FinOps and Brazilian regulatory compliance skills for financial systems

plugins.name: ring-tw-team
plugins.description: Technical writing specialists for functional and API documentation. 3 specialized agents (functional-writer, api-writer, docs-reviewer) and 7 documentation skills covering voice/tone, structure, API field descriptions, and quality review. Enforces clear, consistent documentation standards.

plugins.name: ring-frontend-team
plugins.description: Frontend design and UX principles: UX psychology (Hick's Law, Fitts' Law, Gestalt), color systems (60-30-10 rule), typography scales, motion/animation (easing, micro-interactions, reduced-motion), component patterns with accessibility (WCAG/POUR, ARIA, keyboard nav), and responsive mobile-first design. 3 skills with reference files for design thinking and decision-making.

plugins.name: ring-seo-team
plugins.description: SEO fundamentals and optimization: E-E-A-T framework, Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS), technical SEO, Schema markup, and AI content guidelines. 1 comprehensive skill for search engine visibility.

plugins.name: ring-writing-team
plugins.description: PT-BR writing quality skills: a Humanizer that detects and removes 'cara de IA' (AI tells - clichés, em-dash overuse, robotic phrasing, literal English calques) from Portuguese text while preserving meaning and inventing no facts. 1 skill with an exhaustive AI-tell catalog and before/after rewrite patterns.

plugins.name: ring-skills-team
plugins.description: Meta-skill for the Claude Code skill system: when to create a skill vs CLAUDE.md vs command vs hook, how skills auto-activate by context (progressive disclosure), where to find existing skills (skills.sh, anthropics/skills, Ring marketplace) before building, Windows install scopes, and SKILL.md anatomy. 1 skill + anatomy reference.

plugins.name: ring-media-team
plugins.description: Narrated screen-recording video demos of web systems: explores the live UI with Playwright, generates a PT-BR script, synthesizes male neural narration (edge-tts), records segments (with login + 2FA support), and composes burned-in synced subtitles with ffmpeg. Delivers a 16:9 YouTube master (~3-4min) and a derived 9:16 TikTok/Instagram vertical (~1-2min). 1 skill with bundled scripts and references.
